lines.t: Hey, how’s it going? You look busy.
I am. I need to send this report to our manager before four.
Do you need a hand with anything?
Thanks. Can you check these prices? Something doesn’t look right.
Sure. Give me a minute. Are these prices per person?
Yes, but the last one includes lunch for two people.
Oh, fair enough. The numbers look right to me now.
Great, thanks. Do you want to grab lunch after this?
Not today. I need to pick up my daughter. Thanks anyway.
No worries. Another time, then. NOTICE gạch chân từ hỏi, khoanh DODOES hoặc BE, rồi nối với câu trả lời.
